design: Built after the first held-out set proved too easy to separate the agents (baseline 28/32). Targets documented failure modes of web-search research: point-in-time (as-of) questions, figures only in filing notes for mid/small caps, multi-step fiscal calculations, presumptive traps, guidance vs actual, plus 2 web-favoring news questions. Built blind by a research subagent from SEC filings; it never saw either agent's outputs.
verification: 216 programmatic checks by the builder; 9/9 XBRL cross-checks by the main agent
rule: Frozen before either agent's first run on it; no agent code changes in response to its results.
